svg.text: Pile In: Closed Order versus Closed Order
The attacker charged into the defender’s front arc and touched its front edge at an angle. Step 1: the attacker rotates until its front
is flush with that edge. Step 2: it slides until it is centred. If the attacker cannot get flush, for example because another enemy
unit is in the way, the defender rotates and slides to meet it instead (steps 3 and 4), unless it is touching another enemy.
